prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent shield-face atlas for a realistic painted medieval strategy game.
Primary request: Nine DIFFERENT shields, each alone, upright, flat and viewed exactly straight on from the front. A precise 3 by 3 grid of equally spaced cells on a genuinely transparent background with alpha. No people or arms, no crossed weapons, no text, no checkerboard. Every whole shield remains entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent margins. Row1 left to right: (1) polished but worn bronze round shield with embossed radial sun boss, dark teal insets and fine crownwardens craft; (2) round iron-rimmed shield painted deep teal with a restrained small brass crown emblem and hammered boss, for a spearman; (3) humble round blue-gray wooden militia shield with central iron boss and visible plank grain. Row2: (4) broad heavy dark teal round infantry shield, thick bronze rim, old scratches and radial rivets; (5) small elegant teal round cavalry shield, bronze boss and simple gold sun motif; (6) rustic dark round thorn-clan shield, rough wood, iron boss, bone and red cord details around the rim, no spikes extending outside shield. Row3: (7) small rough warm-brown round levy shield, central iron boss, a restrained red painted band; (8) very tall oval hidewall shield with vertical weathered dark timber planks, tough stitched-hide rim, two iron braces and central reinforced boss, dark red accents; (9) small cavalry shield of dark hide over wood, rust-red edging and a modest iron boss.
Style: high-detail natural hand-painted realism matching an original first-age fantasy RTS; believable warm metal, leather, worn pigment, wood grain. Upper-left soft warm key, restrained highlights, no dramatic cast shadows outside silhouettes. Accurate round/oval physical geometry; circular shields truly circular, not perspective ellipses. Preserve distinct designs and avoid unrelated heraldry, writing or decorative objects. Do not draw their backs. All nine are production cutouts, front-facing. Large square image, preferably 2048x2048.
note: Nine original frontal shield designs; output copied unchanged with original alpha. Source rectangles measured from alpha components.
